verses.en: The sons of Judah; Pharez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Judá: Pérez, Hezrom, Carmi, Hur e Sobal.
verses.en_web: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron and Carmi and Hur and Shobal.

verses.en: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begat Jahath; and Jahath begat Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.
verses.pt: Reaías, filho de Sobal, foi pai de Jaate, e Jaate de Aümai e Laade; estas são as famílias dos zoratitas.
verses.en_web: Reaiah the son of Shobal became the father of Jahath; and Jahath became the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.
verses.en_bbe: And Reaiah, the son of Shobal, was the father of Jahath; and Jahath was the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.

verses.en: And these were of the father of Etam; Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash: and the name of their sister was Hazelelponi:
verses.pt: Estes foram os filhos de Etã: Jizreel, Ismá, e Idbás; e o nome da irmã deles era Hazelelponi;
verses.en_web: These were the sons of the father of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. The name of their sister was Hazzelelponi.
verses.en_bbe: And these were the sons of Hur, the father of Etam: Jezreel and Ishma and Idbash, and the name of their sister was Hazzelelponi;

verses.en: And Penuel the father of Gedor and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah, the father of Bethlehem.
verses.pt: e mais Penuel, pai de Gedor, e Ézer, pai de Husá; estes foram os filhos de Hur, o primogênito de Efrata, pai de Belém.
verses.en_web: Penuel was the father of Gedor and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethlehem.
verses.en_bbe: And Penuel, the father of Gedor, and Ezer, the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the oldest son of Ephrathah, the father of Beth-lehem.

verses.en: And Ashur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
verses.pt: Asur, pai de Tecoa, tinha duas mulheres: Helá e Naará.
verses.en_web: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
verses.en_bbe: And Ashhur, the father of Tekoa, had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

verses.en: And Naarah bare him Ahuzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
verses.pt: Naará deu-lhe à luz Aüzão, Hefer, Temêni e Haastári; estes foram os filhos de Naará.
verses.en_web: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
verses.en_bbe: And Naarah had Ahuzzam by him, and Hepher and Temeni and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.

verses.en: And the sons of Helah were, Zereth, and Jezoar, and Ethnan.
verses.pt: E os filhos de Helá: Zerete, Izar e Etnã.
verses.en_web: The sons of Helah were Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Helah were Zereth, Izhar and Ethnan.

verses.en: And Coz begat Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
verses.pt: Coz foi pai de Anube e Zobeba, e das famílias de Acarel, filho de Harum.
verses.en_web: Hakkoz became the father of Anub, Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
verses.en_bbe: And Koz was the father of Anub and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.

verses.en: And Jabez was more honourable than his brethren: and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bare him with sorrow.
verses.pt: Jabes foi mais ilustre do que seus irmãos (sua mãe lhe pusera o nome de Jabes, dizendo: Porquanto com dores o dei à luz)..
verses.en_web: Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother named him Jabez, saying, “Because I bore him with sorrow.”
verses.en_bbe: And Jabez was honoured more than his brothers; but his mother had given him the name Jabez, saying, Because I gave birth to him with sorrow.

verses.en: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my coast, and that thine hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep me from evil, that it may not grieve me! And God granted him that which he requested.
verses.pt: Jabes invocou o Deus de Israel, dizendo: Oxalá que me abençoes, e estendas os meus termos; que a tua mão seja comigo e faças que do mal eu não seja afligido! E Deus lhe concedeu o que lhe pedira.
verses.en_web: Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, “Oh that you would bless me indeed, and enlarge my border! May your hand be with me, and may you keep me from evil, that I may not cause pain!” God granted him that which he requested.
verses.en_bbe: And Jabez made a prayer to the God of Israel, saying, If only you would truly give me a blessing, and make wider the limits of my land, and let your hand be with me, and keep me from evil, so that I may not be troubled by it! And God gave him his desire.

verses.en: And Chelub the brother of Shuah begat Mehir, which was the father of Eshton.
verses.pt: Quelube, irmão de Suá, foi pai de Meir; e este foi pai de Estom.
verses.en_web: Chelub the brother of Shuhah became the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.
verses.en_bbe: And Chelub, the brother of Shuhah, was the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.

verses.en: And Eshton begat Beth-rapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir-nahash. These are the men of Rechah.
verses.pt: Estom foi pai de Bete-Rafa, Paséia e Teína, que foi pai de Ir-Naás; estes foram os homens, de Reca.
verses.en_web: Eshton became the father of Beth Rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir Nahash. These are the men of Recah.
verses.en_bbe: And Eshton was the father of Bethrapha and Paseah and Tehinnah, the father of Ir-nahash. These are the men of Recah.

verses.en: And the sons of Kenaz; Othniel, and Seraiah: and the sons of Othniel; Hathath.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Quenaz: Otniel e Seraías; e Otniel foi pai de Hatate
verses.en_web: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah; and the sons of Othniel: Hathath.

verses.en: And Meonothai begat Ophrah: and Seraiah begat Joab, the father of the valley of Charashim; for they were craftsmen.
verses.pt: e Meonotai, que foi pai de Ofra; Seraías foi pai de Joabe, fundador de Ge-Harasim, cujos habitantes foram artífices.
verses.en_web: Meonothai became the father of Ophrah: and Seraiah became the father of Joab the father of Ge Harashim; for they were craftsmen.
verses.en_bbe: And Meonothai was the father of Ophrah; and Seraiah was the father of Joab, the father of Ge-harashim; they were expert workmen.

verses.en: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh; Iru, Elah, and Naam: and the sons of Elah, even Kenaz.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Calebe, filho de Jefoné: æru, Elá e Naã; e Elá foi pai de Quenaz:
verses.en_web: The sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Caleb, the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam; and the son of Elah: Kenaz.

verses.en: And the sons of Jehaleleel; Ziph, and Ziphah, Tiria, and Asareel.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Jealelel: Zife, Zifá, Tíria e Asareel.
verses.en_web: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Jehallelel: Ziph and Ziphah, Tiria and Asarel.

verses.en: And the sons of Ezra were, Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon: and she bare Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Ezra: Jeter, Merede, Efer e Jalom; e ela deu à luz Miriã, Samai, e Isbá, pai de Estemoa,
verses.en_web: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon; and she bore Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Ezrah: Jether and Mered and Epher and Jalon; and these are the sons of Bithiah, the daughter of Pharaoh, the wife of Mered. And she became the mother of Miriam and Shammai and Ishbah, the father of Eshtemoa.

verses.en: And his wife Jehudijah bare Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Socho, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. And these are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, which Mered took.
verses.pt: cuja mulher judia deu à luz Jerede, pai de Gedor, Heber, pai de Socó, e Jecutiel, pai de Zanoa; e estes foram os filhos de Bitia, filha de Faraó, que Merede tomou.
verses.en_web: His wife the Jewess bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. These are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.
verses.en_bbe: And his wife, a woman of the tribe of Judah, became the mother of Jered, the father of Gedor, and Heber, the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel, the father of Zanoah.

verses.en: And the sons of his wife Hodiah the sister of Naham, the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite.
verses.pt: Os filhos da mulher de Hodias, irmã de Naã, foram os pais de Queila, o garmita, e Estemoa, o maacatita.
verses.en_web: The sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.

verses.en: And the sons of Shimon were, Amnon, and Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi were, Zoheth, and Ben-zoheth.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Simão: Amnom, Rina, Bene-Hanã e Tilom; e os filhos de Isi: Zoete e Bene-Zoete.
verses.en_web: The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben Hanan, and Tilon. The sons of Ishi: Zoheth, and Ben Zoheth.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Shimon: Amnon and Rinnah, Ben-hanan and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi: Zoheth; and the son of Zoheth. ...

verses.en: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah were, Er the father of Lecah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of them that wrought fine linen, of the house of Ashbea,
verses.pt: Os filhos de Selá, filho de Judá: Er, pai de Leca, Lada, pai de Maressa, e as famílias da casa dos que fabricavam linho, em Bete-Asbéia;
verses.en_web: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of those who worked fine linen, of the house of Ashbea;
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Shelah, the son of Judah: Er, the father of Lecah, and Laadah, the father of Mareshah, and the families of those who made delicate linen, of the family of Ashbea;

verses.en: And Jokim, and the men of Chozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had the dominion in Moab, and Jashubi-lehem. And these are ancient things.
verses.pt: como também Joquim, e os homens de Cozeba, e Joás e Sarafe, os quais dominavam sobre Moabe, e Jasúbi-Leém. (Estes registros são antigos.)
verses.en_web: and Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. These records are ancient.
verses.en_bbe: And Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash and Saraph, who were rulers in Moab, and went back to Beth-lehem. And the records are very old.

verses.en: These were the potters, and those that dwelt among plants and hedges: there they dwelt with the king for his work.
verses.pt: Estes foram os oleiros, os habitantes de Netaim e de Gedera; e moravam ali com o rei para o seu serviço.
verses.en_web: These were the potters, and the inhabitants of Netaim and Gederah: they lived there with the king for his work.
verses.en_bbe: These were the potters, and the people living among planted fields with walls round them; they were there to do the king's work.

verses.en: The sons of Simeon were, Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul:
verses.pt: Os filhos de Simeão: Nemuel, Jamim, Jaribe, Zerá e Saul,
verses.en_web: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;

verses.en: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.
verses.pt: de quem foi filho Salum, de quem foi filho Mibsão, de quem foi filho Misma.
verses.en_web: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, and Mishma his son.
verses.en_bbe: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.

verses.en: And the sons of Mishma; Hamuel his son, Zacchur his son, Shimei his son.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Misma: Jamuel, seu filho, de quem foi filho Zacur, de quem foi filho Simei.
verses.en_web: The sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.

verses.en: And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brethren had not many children, neither did all their family multiply, like to the children of Judah.
verses.pt: Simei teve dezesseis filhos e seis filhas; porém seus irmãos não tiveram muitos filhos, nem se multiplicou toda a sua família tanto como as dos filhos de Judá.
verses.en_web: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brothers didn’t have many children, and all their family did not multiply like the children of Judah.
verses.en_bbe: And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters, but his brothers had only a small number of children, and their family was not as fertile as the children of Judah.

verses.en: And they dwelt at Beer-sheba, and Moladah, and Hazar-shual,
verses.pt: Eles habitaram em Berseba, Molada, Hazar-Sual,
verses.en_web: They lived at Beersheba, Moladah, Hazarshual,
verses.en_bbe: And they were living at Beer-sheba and Moladah and Hazar-shual,

verses.en: And at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad,
verses.pt: Bila, Ezem, Tolade,
verses.en_web: at Bilhah, at Ezem, at Tolad,
verses.en_bbe: And at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad,

verses.en: And at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,
verses.pt: Betuel, Horma, Ziclague,
verses.en_web: at Bethuel, at Hormah, at Ziklag,
verses.en_bbe: And at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,

verses.en: And at Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susim, and at Beth-birei, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities unto the reign of David.
verses.pt: Bete-Marcabote, Hazar-Susim, Bete-Biri e Saraim; essas foram as suas cidades até o reinado de Davi.
verses.en_web: at Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susim, at Beth Biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities until David’s reign.
verses.en_bbe: And at Beth-marcaboth, and at Hazarsusim, and at Beth-biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their towns till David became king.

verses.en: And their villages were, Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities:
verses.pt: As suas aldeias foram: Etã, Aim, Rimom, Toquem e Asã, cinco cidades,
verses.en_web: Their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan, five cities;
verses.en_bbe: And their small towns were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen and Ashan, five towns;

verses.en: And all their villages that were round about the same cities, unto Baal. These were their habitations, and their genealogy.
verses.pt: com todas as suas aldeias, que estavam em redor destas cidades, até Baal. Estas foram as suas habitações e as suas genealogias.
verses.en_web: and all their villages that were around the same cities, to Baal. These were their settlements, and they have their genealogy.
verses.en_bbe: And all the small places round these towns, as far as Baalath-beer, the high place of the South. These were their living-places, and they have lists of their generations.

verses.en: And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah the son of Amaziah,
verses.pt: Ora, Mesobabe, Jamleque, Josa, filho dc Amazias,
verses.en_web: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah the son of Amaziah,
verses.en_bbe: And Meshobab and Jamlech and Joshah, the son of Amaziah,

verses.en: And Joel, and Jehu the son of Josibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
verses.pt: Joel, Jeú, filho de Josibias, filho de Seraías, filho de Asiel,
verses.en_web: Joel, Jehu the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
verses.en_bbe: And Joel and Jehu, the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,

verses.en: And Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah,
verses.pt: Elioenai, Jaacobá, Jesoaías, Asaías, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaías,
verses.en_web: Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,
verses.en_bbe: And Elioenai and Jaakobah and Jeshohaiah and Asaiah and Adiel and Jesimiel and Benaiah,

verses.en: And Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah;
verses.pt: e Ziza, filho de Sifi, filho de Alom, filho de Jedaías, filho de Sínri, filho de Semaías
verses.en_web: and Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah—
verses.en_bbe: And Ziza, the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah;

verses.en: These mentioned by their names were princes in their families: and the house of their fathers increased greatly.
verses.pt: estes, registrados por nome, foram príncipes nas suas famílias; e as famílias de seus pais se multiplicaram grandemente.
verses.en_web: these mentioned by name were princes in their families. Their fathers’ houses increased greatly.
verses.en_bbe: These, whose names are given, were chiefs in their families, and their families became very great in number.

verses.en: And they went to the entrance of Gedor, even unto the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
verses.pt: Chegaram até a entrada de Gedor, ao lado oriental do vale, em busca de pasto para os seus rebanhos;
verses.en_web: They went to the entrance of Gedor, even to the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
verses.en_bbe: And they went to the opening into Gedor, as far as the east side of the valley, in search of grass-land for their flocks.

verses.en: And they found fat pasture and good, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceable; for they of Ham had dwelt there of old.
verses.pt: e acharam pasto abundante e bom, e a terra era espaçosa, quieta e pacífica; pois os que antes habitavam ali eram descendentes de Cão.
verses.en_web: They found fat pasture and good, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceful; for those who lived there before were descended from Ham.
verses.en_bbe: And they came to some good fertile grass-land, in a wide quiet country of peace-loving people; for the people who were living there before were of the offspring of Ham.

verses.en: And these written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and smote their tents, and the habitations that were found there, and destroyed them utterly unto this day, and dwelt in their rooms: because there was pasture there for their flocks.
verses.pt: Estes que estão inscritos por nome, vieram nos dias de Ezequias, rei de Judá, e destruíram as tendas e os meunins que se acharam ali, e os exterminaram totalmente até o dia de hoje, e habitaram em lugar deles; porque ali havia pasto para os seus rebanhos.
verses.en_web: These written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and struck their tents. The Meunim who were found there, and they destroyed them utterly to this day, and lived in their place; because there was pasture there for their flocks.
verses.en_bbe: And these whose names are given came in the days of Hezekiah, king of Judah, and made an attack on the Meunim who were living there, and put an end to them to this day, and took their place, because there was grass there for their flocks.

verses.en: And some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.
verses.pt: Também deles, isto é, dos filhos de Simeão, quinhentos homens foram ao monte Seir, tendo por capitães Pelatias, Nearias, Refaías e Uziel, filhos de Isi,
verses.en_web: Some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to Mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.
verses.en_bbe: And some of them, five hundred of the sons of Simeon, went to the hill-country of Seir, with Pelatiah and Neariah and Rephaiah and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi, at their head.

verses.en: And they smote the rest of the Amalekites that were escaped, and dwelt there unto this day.
verses.pt: e, matando o restante dos amalequitas, que havia escapado, ficaram habitando ali até o dia de hoje.
verses.en_web: They struck the remnant of the Amalekites who escaped, and have lived there to this day.
verses.en_bbe: And they put to death the rest of the Amalekites who had got away safely, and made it their living-place to this day.
